sources.title: MiniMax H3 Turbo LoRA: Faster Local Video Gen in ComfyUI | MindStudio
sources.snippet: The MiniMax H3 Turbo LoRA is a small adapter file that speeds up sampling for MiniMax H3, a 33 billion parameter model that generates video with synchronized stereo audio in a single pass.

sources.title: drbaph/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora-ComfyUI · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository contains MiniMax-H3 Turbo and few-step LoRAs converted and optimized for ComfyUI.

sources.title: taurusduan/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Custom nodes: Larryvrh/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo — or search "MiniMax-H3 Turbo" in ComfyUI-Manager. (Keep the node updated; it evolves alongside these weights.) Install the nodes (Manager, or git clone into ComfyUI/custom_nodes) and put a .safetensors from this repo into ComfyUI/models/loras/. You also need the base MiniMax-H3 model, VAEs and text encoder — see the MiniMax-H3 tutorial.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 Turbo LoRA in ComfyUI: 4-Step Setup and Fixes
sources.snippet: The LoRA is larryvrh's, and the current file is minimax_h3_turbo_4step_ema_ckpt850.safetensors. It is bf16, about 744 MB, applied as an ordinary low-rank update with alpha set equal to rank, so there is no hidden scaling factor to reason about.

sources.title: GitHub - Larryvrh/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo · GitHub
sources.snippet: cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes git clone https://github.com/larryvrh/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo · Then restart ComfyUI. Keep the node updated (Manager, or git pull) — it evolves alongside the weights. Put the LoRA .safetensors into ComfyUI/models/loras/. You also need the base MiniMax-H3 model, VAEs and text encoder from the official release — see the MiniMax-H3 tutorial.
